source: completed Hyperliquid 5m candles; aggregate exactly to UTC 1h/4h
signal_rule: LONG if percent close change across exactly 3 completed higher-timeframe bars >= threshold; SHORT if <= -threshold; else NONE
signal_timestamp: must be timestamp of final completed candle; observed_at>=candle.closed_at and strictly after not_before_utc
baseline: frozen v6.9 seven-engine signal set, same contemporaneous underlying market data; no live changes
execution: No executable fill is assumed and directional checks cannot be relabeled net trading profit
comparison: Matched forward-only observed opportunities and independent later price outcomes, costs measured separately; no historical selection
validation: multiple-testing-controlled CI, net fees+funding+slippage, drawdown and correlated exposures
